verdict.rationale: The pack has no formal independent leaderboard or third-party evaluation results for DeepSeek. The only support is informal hands-on comparisons by community members: one compares outputs across DeepSeek versions via OpenRouter, and another reruns personal tests against o1. Benchmark figures cited in community threads appear to be vendor-reported. Missing for 10: evidence of placement on recognized independent leaderboards (e.g. arena-style or third-party benchmark suites), named third-party evaluation reports, and documentation linking to independent results.
